lookups.why: Check what exists at the top-level vendor directory before the path change.
Check whether the new target path contains a valid crate directory (Cargo.toml, src/).
Check whether the old package path was a workspace root or a crate root.
Verify the new target has a valid Cargo.toml with the expected package name and features.

value.summary: The diff changes a path in a dependency declaration. I need to verify what is at both the old and new paths to know whether the reference is broken or regresses. I will read the old path and the new path to confirm the target crate exists with the expected interface.
